gold: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation

selector.rationale: ECG findings of right axis deviation, prolonged QRS duration with rsR' complexes in lead V1, and wide S waves in leads I and V6 support Brugada syndrome

rejected.label: Acute coronary syndrome
rejected.why: No acute occlusions found on coronary angiography and initial rhythm was pulseless electrical activity, not typical of acute coronary syndrome
